The guidance message for a name/target mismatch

Source: R/quarto-table.R
apa_quarto_target_message.Rd

Used when a chunk calls an entry point that does not match the render target, e.g. apa.quarto.pdf() in a document rendering to Word. The table renders correctly either way, because the render target decides the mechanism and the function name does not; the message states the one useful fact, which YAML line would make the two agree. A separate internal function so the tests can check the wording directly.

Usage

apa_quarto_target_message(called, actual)

Arguments

called

the format key of the function that was called ("pdf", "docx", "html", or "revealjs").

actual

the RAW render-target token, e.g. from apa_quarto_actual_format() ("latex", "docx", "html", ...) – not yet normalized to a format key; this function does that itself via apa_quarto_actual_entry().

Value

A length-1 character string.
